1.title: ICE told to halt most vehicle stops after pair of fatal shootings
1.summary: It marks a major policy shift for the immigration enforcement agency, which has faced criticism in the past year over allegations of excessive use of force.

2.title: Millions in Canada swelter as heatwave continues to move east
2.summary: High temperatures are expected to continue for Canada, as well as for parts of the US Midwest and Northeast, into Wednesday.

3.title: 'Miracle on the Hudson' pilot Captain Sully diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease
3.summary: The 75-year-old says he was recently diagnosed and the disease is at an early stage.

4.title: U.S. and Iran Reignite War Over Strait of Hormuz
4.summary: The two countries slid back to open war over the waterway, as the U.S. planned to reinstate a blockade on Iranian ports on Tuesday. Iran said it had attacked two tankers and fired at U.S. military sites.

5.title: Trump scraps threat of 20% fee on Hormuz cargo as US resumes blockade of Iran ports
5.summary: Trump drops a 24-hour-old vow to charge cargo ships for using the Strait as the US continues its battle to break Iran's hold on the waterway.

6.title: 'If we die, we die together': Wife of man nearly sucked out of Ryanair plane speaks of ordeal
6.summary: Svetlana Grković told Serbian media that her husband is "seriously injured and in shock".
